preview.behavior: Server runs validation and computes the server-side chance, then returns before consumables/q/placeholder mutation.
preview.policy: Planning may use preview as fresh server evidence, but execution must still revalidate the exact physical inputs immediately before the real send.

correlation.implication: At most one managed in-flight request per respective channel; FIFO result correlation is not safe under parallel writes.

gradeFunction.formula: grade=4 if level>=grades[3], else 3 if >=grades[2], else 2 if >=grades[1], else 1 if >=grades[0], else 0; default grades=[9,10,11,12]

acceptedExecutionBoundary: Server validates all supplied physical indexes and compatibility.
On accepted real execution, required consumables are consumed before the timed q phase completes.
A q entry and placeholder represent an accepted multi-phase mutation, not a harmless UI state.
Outcome state is precomputed/stored in player.p before the q timer expires.

effects: massproduction halves duration and is consumed
massproductionpp divides duration by ten and is consumed
massproduction.policy: These character conditions are part of the action effect domain and must be included in pre/post-state evidence if present.

normalUpgradeScroll.compatibility: current item grade must be <= scroll grade; grade 4 is max_level. scroll4 has grade 3.6 and is therefore compatible through grade 3.
normalUpgradeScroll.graceRaw: max(0, min(new_level+1, item.grace + min(3,player.p.ugrace[new_level]/4.5) + item_def.igrace) + min(6,S.ugrace[new_level]/3.0) + player.p.ograce/3.2)
normalUpgradeScroll.higherGradeScroll: if scroll.grade > item grade && new_level<=10: probability=probability*1.2+0.01; high=true; real execution also adds 0.4 item grace
offeringModifiers: offering.grade > grade+1: probability=probability*1.7 + grace*4; high=true; item grace increase 3
offering.grade > grade: probability=probability*1.5 + grace*1.2; high=true; item grace increase 1
offering.grade == grade: probability=probability*1.4 + grace; item grace increase 0.4
offering.grade == grade-1: probability=probability*1.15 + grace/3.2; item grace increase 0.2
otherwise: probability=probability*1.08 + grace/4; item grace increase 0.1
additionalStateChanges: real higher-grade scroll path may add item.grace += 0.4
real offering path adds item.grace by offering tier
real execution has independent 2.5% bonus-grace roll adding 1 item grace
success/failure updates player/server grace accumulators and player.p.ograce

serverRollAdjustment.playerItemNumOrigin: server_functions assigns player.p.item_num a random integer 0..41 when undefined
serverRollAdjustment.consequence: The returned preview chance is the probability threshold, but this additional roll transformation can change effective success probability for the selected inventory slot.

normalUpgradeScroll.timing: 500 * new_level * sqrt(new_level) * tmult milliseconds; tmult=1/1.5/2 from original grade 0/1/2; hardcore forces 500ms; massproduction modifiers then apply according to source order.
realStartMutationOrder: compute probability/result and mutate applicable grace state
replace target inventory slot with placeholder

failureSemantics.ordinaryScroll: Failure stores original item in u_itemx; terminal q completion clears placeholder, so target item is destroyed.
failureSemantics.ultimateScroll4: Because scroll grade is 3.6, failed roll stores original item in u_item plus u_fail=true; terminal response is upgrade_fail but the target item is restored/preserved.
failureSemantics.resultWarning: success:false does not always mean target item was destroyed; postcondition must inspect the actual inventory.

normalUpgradeScroll.successSemantics: Target item level becomes new_level before q completes; terminal completion restores it into the placeholder slot and emits upgrade_success.

statScroll.compatibility: item must support stat and current grade <= pscroll grade
statScroll.offeringEffect: If an offering is supplied, it is consumed, item.grace += 1, and success is forced regardless of the 0.99999 roll.
statScroll.mutation: item.stat_type becomes scroll_def.stat before the q timer completes
statScroll.terminalAdditionalResponse: Server also queues generic upgrade_success for a successful stat path; the FIFO deferred is expected to be resolved by the earlier stat-specific response.
statScroll.failure: Without offering, the rare failed roll destroys the target item.

primordialTypeOffering.behavior: No scroll + normal type='offering': guaranteed non-level-changing grace infusion.
primordialTypeOffering.effect: consume offering, item.grace += 0.5, u_type='offering', target item preserved
primordialTypeOffering.terminalAdditionalResponse: Server also queues generic upgrade_success; domain settlement is item-preserved + grace change, not a level increment.

materialOffering.sourceItems: Items with item definition field offering (e.g. ingot/nugget offering strengths), distinct from type='offering'.
chanceFormula: if material offering strength > original item grade OR strength==2 and item value<=20,000,000: chance=0.32
offering strength < original item grade => invalid offering
materialOffering.outcome: consume material offering; target replaced by placeholder; roll success sets item.p='shiny'; failed roll preserves the target item but marks u_fail=true, so terminal response is upgrade_fail.
materialOffering.consequence: upgrade_fail here means shiny proc failed, not that the target item was destroyed.

terminalResponses.note: Domain settlement is determined from the specific path plus fresh inventory/grace/stat evidence, never from response.success alone.

validation: exactly three distinct integer inventory indexes
not in bank and in service range unless computer
same item name and same level
cscroll type and scroll grade >= item grade
none of the three items locked
offering, if supplied, must be type='offering'
compound.probabilityGradeSelection: igrade starts as def.igrade; when current level>=3 it is recalculated at level-2 using calculate_item_grade(def,{level:itemLevel-2}).
compound.higherGradeScroll: if scroll.grade > current grade: probability=probability*1.1+0.001; grace_bonus +=0.4 on real execution; high=(scroll.grade-grade)
offeringModifiers: offering.grade > grade+1: probability=probability*1.64 + grace*2; high=true; grace increase 3
offering.grade > grade: probability=probability*1.48 + grace; high=true; grace increase 1
offering.grade == grade: probability=probability*1.36 + min(0.81,grace); grace increase 0.5
offering.grade == grade-1: probability=probability*1.15 + min(0.475,grace)/max(itemLevel-2,1); grace increase 0.2
compound.noOffering: grace=0.007*(sum(item.grace)+player.p.ograce); probability += min(0.175,grace)/max(itemLevel-1,1); real output item grace starts from max of input graces
compound.realGraceMerge: On real execution, item0 grace first aggregates input grace when offering is present or max input grace when absent, then item0.grace = item0.grace/6.4 + grace_bonus.
compound.cap: For non-booster items probability <= min(oprobability*(3 + (high ? high*0.6 : 0)), oprobability + 0.2 + (high ? high*0.05 : 0)).

boosterSpecialCase.extraLevelLoop: while offering && random<proc: extra++, level++, proc/=2
boosterSpecialCase.durationMerge: Three booster durations are combined; active expiries are converted to remaining seconds and output expiry becomes future_s(totalSeconds/3) when any input was active.
boosterSpecialCase.consequence: Preview reports near-certain base compound success but does not enumerate the random recursive extra-level proc outcome.

compound.timing: 10000ms; hardcore 1200ms; massproduction halves; massproductionpp divides by ten.
realStartMutationOrder: consume offering if supplied and update grace inputs
replace first input slot with placeholder
remove second and third input slots immediately
successSemantics: item0 level becomes new_level before q completes
one output item survives in first slot at terminal completion
booster may gain extra levels via recursive offering proc
failureSemantics: all three physical input items are lost
first slot placeholder is cleared at q completion
second and third slots were already null from action start

terminalResponses.clientSemantics: Normal failed compound is a resolved business outcome with success=false rather than a validation rejection.

recovery.criticalBoundary: Once q/placeholder exists, consumables and/or input items have already been mutated and the server has already selected the stored outcome branch.
recovery.placeholderMeaning: Accepted in-flight transaction; not proof that the random result is still undecided.
recovery.stillPending: character.q.<action> plus attributable placeholder exists and terminal inventory has not yet replaced/cleared it.
committedUpgrade: path-specific final target state reconciled: leveled item, preserved scroll4/material-offering failure item, stat mutation, grace infusion, or destroyed target
committedCompound: all three input identities/slots accounted for
success output or three-item loss reconciled
recovery.notApplied: Only positive evidence that no accepted mutation occurred: pinned physical inputs/consumables/conditions all remain unchanged and no attributable q/placeholder exists.
recovery.crashOrDisconnect: UNKNOWN -> REOBSERVE -> RECONCILE; never resend the same attempt.
recovery.responseRule: A terminal Promise response is useful evidence but cannot replace postcondition reconciliation, especially because upgrade_fail has path-dependent preservation/destruction semantics and stale responses may not resolve the active deferred.

invariants: Preview mode never authorizes execution by itself; exact physical inputs are revalidated immediately before real send.
An accepted real upgrade/compound is considered mutation-started once consumables/q/placeholder state changes; no same-intent retry follows timeout/disconnect.
Placeholder is a transaction marker, not proof that the random outcome remains undecided.
Upgrade and compound retain separate FIFO action channels and may not be parallelized within the same channel.
Normal upgrade failure may destroy the target, but scroll4 failure preserves it; response success=false alone cannot classify item loss.
Material-offering shiny failure preserves the target despite upgrade_fail.
Offering-only primordial grace infusion does not increase item level even though the server may also queue generic upgrade_success.
Stat-scroll success changes stat_type rather than item level; postcondition is path-specific.
Compound failure consumes all three physical input items.
Compound success yields one output and consumes exactly two additional equal inputs plus scroll/offering as applicable.
All upgrade/compound physical item identities, consumables, q state and massproduction conditions are resource-claimed until terminal settlement.
Server-reported preview chance is stored with the exact source/inputs; it is not treated as a timeless formula result.

Upgrade actual roll has a source-verified target-slot adjustment tied to player.p.item_num; effective outcome probability must not be inferred solely from the displayed threshold when that condition may apply.
Booster compound extra levels are a post-success random proc and must be reconciled from the final item rather than predicted as a single deterministic level.
No planner may infer NOT_APPLIED from missing terminal response, missing output, or reconnect alone.
